The following contains the team squads for the Beijing [[2008 Summer Olympics]].

Pete Orr was originally named to the team, but pulled out when he was called up to the major league roster of the [[Washington Nationals]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2008-07-25 |title=Orr backs out of Canadian baseball team |url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/2.720/orr-backs-out-of-canadian-baseball-team-1.696791 |access-date=2024-10-29 |website=CBC}}</ref> He was replaced by 22-year-old [[Emmanuel Garcia]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2008-07-28 |title=Emmanuel Garcia Headed To Beijing |url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/emmanuel-garcia-headed-to-beijing/n-3690973 |access-date=2024-10-29 |website=OurSports Central |language=en}}</ref> [[Scott Richmond]] was also removed from the team when he was called up by the [[Toronto Blue Jays]]. Pitcher [[James Avery (baseball)|James Avery]] was named as a replacement.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2008-07-31 |title=Avery tabbed to replace pitcher Richmond on Olympic team |url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/2.720/avery-tabbed-to-replace-pitcher-richmond-on-olympic-team-1.760266 |access-date=2024-10-29 |website=CBC |agency=The Canadian Press}}</ref>

Accessed August 13, 2008.</ref> The Chinese Taipei National baseball team could only finish the Olympics with the remaining 23 players.
